title: Loan Calculator
description: This is an Angular app that works as a Loan Calculator. All the simulations a user makes are stored in Local Storage and the user can edit and delete a simulation. The app uses PWA functionality and users can install this app on their mobile devices or PCs as a standalone app.

title: Course Scheduler
description: Works together with the School Manager App. This app receives requests via an API from the school manager app to schedule sessions for newly added courses. School admins can schedule all sessions, check for conflicts, and send back the schedule via API to the school manager app.

title: School Manager
description: An Angular project for teachers, students, and school admins to track school activities. Teachers can grade students and mark attendance. Students can enroll in classes, attend them, and view their grades. School admins can manage and see an overview of everything.

title: Expense Tracker
description: An Angular team project that helps you track your expenses and add them by scanning receipts.

title: Angular Template Page
description: A template project for Angular that uses authentication, routing, guards, and translation features.

title: Sports Tracker
description: An Angular project with responsive design to track scores in various sports.

title: Personal Dashboard
description: A dashboard-type web app. In this team project, I built the currency converter feature.

title: Coming Soon Page
description: A 'Coming Soon' page for projects in development.

title: Timekeeping & HR App
description: An application for managing timekeeping and human resources.

title: Flex vs. Grid
description: A comparison between Flexbox and Grid layouts.

title: Tip Calculator
description: A tip calculator with a random generator to decide which friend pays the bill.

title: Currency Converter
description: A simple currency converter that fetches data from an API.
